description: Price cells and return a ready-to-send x402 request (URL, method, headers, JSON body, exact amount). Nothing is reserved or charged. Send it with an x402 client (x402-fetch, x402-axios, @x402/fetch); it pays and creates the order in one request. Raise the client's max amount if the price is above its default cap (x402-fetch 0.10 USDC, @x402/fetch 1 USDC). Cells that already have an owner can be bought over at the overwrite price (get_wall_info prices.rule: the multiplier times the last price while the cell is inside its reset window, otherwise the empty-cell price); total_usd here, and the 402 of the returned request, state the exact amount. Areas map to the HTTP body as [y*1000+x, 0xRRGGBB] pairs.

accepted_terms.description: Must be true: you accept the terms (https://cellionaire.com/terms).

areas.description: One to 20 non-overlapping areas, each a rect + color and/or a list of cells with colours.

cells.description: Individual cells, each with its own colour (instead of or in addition to rect + color): {x, y, color: "#RRGGBB"}, or the HTTP API form [idx, color] with idx = y*1000+x and color = 0xRRGGBB as an integer (e.g. [500100, 2254506] = {x: 100, y: 500, color: "#2266AA"}).

color.description: Colour of every cell in "rect", "#RRGGBB" (required with rect).

rect.description: A rectangle of cells: top-left x, y and width w, height h (cells).

owner.description: Public display name shown on the cells (max 40 characters). Default "anonymous".

name: prepare_x402_order
title: Price cells for an x402 payment
